questions.question: Where [P1] stands, (R378)(13) names the act after b768: it writes the registry's block and the map's merge under the author's strikes with the rulings of (7) in it, takes up W-ORD-NOVEMBER-RIDERS in its two parts, and the navigator brings The Epstein Control Object to the deposit rubric with the proof in it; or another the author names. [P1] stands: controlFailureExists proves ControlFailureExists at ffefddc6, main and v0.46 there. Printed beside it for the author's ruling, first the growth read of (3): the prev-mode dry's seconds over ten parts 4,455.4, 4,669.4 and 5,149.8 at b765, b766 and b767 (data/b768_misses.txt :3). The four parts [K27] holds read 636.2, 587.0, 547.4 and 541.3 s at b767's dry (data/b768_misses.txt :3), and each was held at b768 in every mode, beside the seat's reading of about 2.5 h for [K27] (data/b768_stepzero.txt :110). The price of [G1] as b767 banked it: the DATA parts 400-1,500 lines by hand and 2-5 dispatches, and the enclosures 300-1,000 lines by hand and 1-3 dispatches (data/b767_window.txt :25). Which route does the act after b768 take?

options.label: Registry block and riders (Recommended)
options.description: The act after b768 writes the registry's block and the map's merge under the author's strikes with the rulings of (7) in it, takes up W-ORD-NOVEMBER-RIDERS in its two parts, the errors first and the scope sentences after them, and the navigator brings The Epstein Control Object to the deposit rubric with the proof in it. Recommended: (13) names this route where [P1] stands, and [P1] stands at ffefddc6 with main and v0.46 there. No score is lost on this route, N5's clause binding b768 alone.

options.label: Another route
options.description: The author names the act after b768 in the answer's own words, the proof standing compiled at ffefddc6 with main and v0.46 there whichever route is taken. No score is lost on this route, N5's clause binding b768 alone.
